description: Querying protobuf-encoded data directly from SQLite using protobuf_extract() and protobuf_which_oneof().

panels.description: Each row is a serialised test.Person blob. Fields are extracted at query time using protobuf_extract(); no denormalised columns exist.

targets.queryText: WITH d AS (SELECT data FROM django_sqlite_protobuf_storeddescriptor WHERE name = 'test') SELECT protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'name') AS name, CAST(protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'age') AS INTEGER) AS age, ROUND(CAST(protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'score') AS REAL), 2) AS score, CASE CAST(protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'active') AS INTEGER) WHEN 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS active, protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'address.city') AS city FROM people_personrecord ORDER BY inserted_at DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: WITH d AS (SELECT data FROM django_sqlite_protobuf_storeddescriptor WHERE name = 'test') SELECT protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'name') AS name, CAST(protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'age') AS INTEGER) AS age, ROUND(CAST(protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'score') AS REAL), 2) AS score, CASE CAST(protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'active') AS INTEGER) WHEN 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS active, protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Person', 'address.city') AS city FROM people_personrecord ORDER BY inserted_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: People — protobuf_extract()

panels.description: protobuf_which_oneof() returns the active branch name of the 'source' oneof as a string, enabling GROUP BY on a polymorphic table.

targets.queryText: WITH d AS (SELECT data FROM django_sqlite_protobuf_storeddescriptor WHERE name = 'test') SELECT protobuf_which_oneof(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Record', 'source') AS branch, COUNT(*) AS count FROM people_recordentry GROUP BY branch
targets.rawQueryText: WITH d AS (SELECT data FROM django_sqlite_protobuf_storeddescriptor WHERE name = 'test') SELECT protobuf_which_oneof(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Record', 'source') AS branch, COUNT(*) AS count FROM people_recordentry GROUP BY branch

panels.title: Records by oneof branch — protobuf_which_oneof()

panels.description: Score values extracted from branch_b records only. Inactive-branch fields return NULL (not the proto3 default 0), so the WHERE clause correctly excludes branch_a rows.

targets.queryText: WITH d AS (SELECT data FROM django_sqlite_protobuf_storeddescriptor WHERE name = 'test') SELECT protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Record', 'branch_b.label') AS label, ROUND(CAST(protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Record', 'branch_b.score') AS REAL), 2) AS score FROM people_recordentry WHERE protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Record', 'branch_b.score') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: WITH d AS (SELECT data FROM django_sqlite_protobuf_storeddescriptor WHERE name = 'test') SELECT protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Record', 'branch_b.label') AS label, ROUND(CAST(protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Record', 'branch_b.score') AS REAL), 2) AS score FROM people_recordentry WHERE protobuf_extract(proto_data, (SELECT data FROM d), 'test.Record', 'branch_b.score') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 50
